string-array.name: move_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees until your thighs are about level with the floor.
Press through your whole foot to stand up again.

resources.string: Keep your heels on the floor and your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

string-array.name: move_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Place your hands a little wider than your shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.

resources.string: Keep your belly tight so your hips don\'t sag. Too hard? Start with your knees on the floor.

string-array.name: move_glute_bridge_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with bent knees and your feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower slowly back down.

resources.string: Push through your heels and avoid arching your lower back.

string-array.name: move_split_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with one foot a long step in front of the other, up on the toes of the back foot.
Lower straight down until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push up through the front foot. Do all repetitions, then switch legs.

resources.string: Keep your upper body upright and your front knee over your foot.

string-array.name: move_jumping_jack_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while your arms swing up over your head.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady pace.

resources.string: Land softly on the balls of your feet.

string-array.name: move_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Hold on to a wall for balance if you like.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.

resources.string: Go slowly, especially on the way down.

string-array.name: move_plank_steps
string-array.item: Place your hands under your shoulders and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your body so it is straight from head to heels.
Hold the position and keep breathing calmly.

resources.string: Squeeze your belly and glutes so your hips neither sag nor rise.

string-array.name: move_mountain_climber_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Pull one knee towards your chest, then put the foot back.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.

resources.string: Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your hands.

string-array.name: move_superman_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your stomach with your arms stretched out in front of you.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment, then lower slowly.

resources.string: Look at the floor so your neck stays long. Lifting a few centimetres is enough.

string-array.name: move_reverse_lunge_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a long step back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push off with the front foot back to standing. Do all repetitions, then switch legs.

resources.string: Keep most of your weight on the front foot.

string-array.name: move_good_morning_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Push your hips back and lean forward with a straight back until you feel a stretch in the back of your thighs.
Squeeze your glutes and rise back up.

resources.string: Move from your hips, not your back, and keep your back straight the whole time.

string-array.name: move_bird_dog_steps
string-array.item: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Stretch one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with your back.
Return slowly and switch sides.

resources.string: Keep your back still, as if a glass of water were standing on it.

string-array.name: move_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with bent knees and your feet on the floor.
Tighten your belly and curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching for your knees.
Lower slowly back down.

resources.string: Your lower back stays on the floor. Don\'t pull on your neck.
